topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the students, explains the scope and multi-disciplinary context of the lecture series, and outlines the primary learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Malignant Transformation and In Vitro Tumor Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cumulative genetic and epigenetic alterations disrupt normal differentiation and tissue architecture to drive tumorigenesis, and how these processes are modeled experimentally.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Benign-to-Malignant Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the clinical and histological distinctions between benign and malignant tumors, focusing on basement membrane invasion, metastatic routes, and the stepwise adenoma-to-carcinoma sequence.

topics.label: Tumor Classification and Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions, tissue suffixes, and notable exceptions used to name benign and malignant neoplasms.

topics.label: Pathological Causes of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the mechanical, metabolic, and metastatic mechanisms through which primary and secondary tumors cause systemic illness and patient death.

topics.label: Patterns of Cancer Incidence Across Human and Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the frequency, tissue distribution, and malignancy rates of tumors across human populations and diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and Clinical Applications of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine clinical cancer presentation and evaluate the effectiveness, methodologies, and limitations of population screening programs across various tumor types.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-up and Learning Outcomes Review
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by referring students back to the learning outcomes for revision and practical preparations.
